human_choice.source: current chat; explicit answer "Use GitHub milestones per approved change"

resolver.pagination: Follow every next Link; record each response and terminal page. Stop and mark incomplete when any bound is reached before exhaustion.
resolver.descendants: Traverse each seed issue GET /repos/{owner}/{repo}/issues/{number}/sub_issues recursively. Include all descendants, even outside the milestone, in the approval snapshot; cross-repository descendants require a separately approved repository scope. Record database/node IDs, parent edges and updated_at. Dedupe by repository plus database ID; reject cycles.
resolver.fallback: Native hierarchy unavailable: use documented map task lists plus child Part of links only after explicit resolver-successor acceptance; never silently switch.
resolver.dependencies: GET /repos/{owner}/{repo}/issues/{number}/dependencies/blocked_by for each selected issue, fully paginate. Resolve transitive external blockers within the same finite bounds; verify acyclic graph. Closed external blockers need pinned satisfaction evidence; open/unreadable blockers prevent dependent admission.
resolver.dependency_fallback: Explicitly accepted successor may use documented Blocked by body lines; unsupported native API currently parks affected work.
exclusions: issues outside milestone with no selected descendant relationship
explicit human-approved exclusions, provided they remove no required descendant or dependency
resolver.completeness: All seed, descendant and dependency pages exhausted; all memberships/edges/IDs and versions recorded; no unresolved scope or API failures; recheck drift before admission. Snapshot additions/removals require successor scope approval.
resolver.completion: Every frozen selected descendant independently passes required criteria and human trial disposition is recorded. Tracker closure needs separate action authority.
resolver.trial_stop: Explicit checkpoint ticket IDs selected with the idea proposal; no selection yet.

inspection.scope: state=all, per_page=100 returned empty; no target created

primary_sources.applicability: Milestone-scoped issue query; PR exclusion and pagination.
primary_sources.limitations: Documentation does not prove credentials or runtime resolver correctness.
